title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E11 — On the Bone
Oxtail; slow-roasted beef ribs; cowboy steak; Korean short rib kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E12 — Cheese
Cheese fondue; fettuccine Alfredo; melting raclette; grown-up grilled cheese.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S5 E6 — Entertaining for a Crowd
Chicken kabsa; stuffed cabbage and spiced lamb chops; orzo risotto with wild mushrooms; a sweet cake called kumajj.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S5 E9 — Festive Occasions
Pomegranate skirt steak kebabs; lamb kebabs with yogurt-mint sauce; beef, mushroom and millet kebabs; saffron-yogurt chicken kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S5 E10 — Small Bites
Creamed coconut spinach; eggplant with herbs and yogurt; cauliflower salad with roasted chickpeas; za'atar smashed potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E1 — Eggs
Preparing eggs properly, no matter the style; frying eggs; omelet recipe; foolproof frittata.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E2 — Sauces
Two methods for preparing hollandaise sauce; creamy béchamel sauce; serving French sauce beurre blanc over steamed lobster; marinara sauce made with four ingredients.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E4 — Pound Cake
Variations of the pound cake, from traditional to a version inspired by Asia.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E8 — Pate A Choux
Puff pastry using only four ingredients; cream puffs, éclairs, profiteroles and cheesy gougères.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E9 — Meringue
Pavlova with passion fruit; île flottante; Huguenot torte.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E1 — Coffee Cakes
Rhubarb upside-down crumb cake; jam-filled coffee cake muffins; streusel cake; glazed lemon-blueberry coffee cake.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E13 — Christmas Wreath; Stockings; Christmas Brass Screw
Thatched roofs; Christmas stockings and trees; narcissus baskets; wreaths.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E13 — Christmas Ornaments; Wreaths; Cookie Boxes
Christmas ornaments and wreaths in East Hampton; Christmas cookie boxes.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E85 — Bronx Zoo; Noah's Ark Gingerbread Cookies
Bronx Zoo; pistachio; gingerbread cookies; cookies to hang on the Christmas tree.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S5 E92 — Collecting Ornaments; Florentine Cookies
F.W. Woolworth; collecting ornaments; Florentine cookies.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S1 E4 — Martha's Favorite Christmas Cookies
Martha makes some of her favorite Christmas cookies with the help of her niece, Sophie; plus, Martha shares her incredible cookie-decorating techniques, and ideas for packaging cookies as gifts.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S1 E5 — Gorgeous Gingerbread Houses From Start To Finish
Martha's friend and food stylist Jason Schreiber stops by to help her explain all the steps to making top-notch gingerbread houses.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S1 E6 — Celebrating Christmas
Martha and her friend Kevin celebrate Christmas by whipping up her world-famous eggnog; plus, get tips to elevate your holiday décor, and ideas for beautifully wrapped, easy presents.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S2 E1 — Martha and the Hanukkah Hunks
Martha's called in her Hanukkah hunks to share their family's Hanukkah recipes and teach Martha how to make the most delicious holiday dishes to nosh on.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S2 E2 — Christmas Eve Seafood Dinner
Martha's friend, Chef Eric Ripert shares his take on a Christmas Eve seafood dinner; from tuna carpaccio to filleting flatfish, Eric's expertise will make Christmas Eve dinner unforgettable.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S2 E3 — Christmas in the Country
Martha travels to Stissing House in upstate New York to see how chef and restaurateur Clare de Boer does a beautiful and decadent Christmas dinner in a wood-burning oven.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S2 E4 — Christmas Panettone, Kris Kringle Bread Pudding, and More!
Martha and Pierluigi Mazzella share their Christmas bread traditions by baking panettone bread and Kris Kringle bread pudding; later, Kevin Sharkey constructs an easy yet elegant Christmas wreath.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E7 — A Classic French Dish: Pot Au Feu
Martha prepares pot-au-feu, a hearty French dish of root vegetables and various cuts of meat, all braised in a savory broth; it's served with sliced meat, vegetables and delicious accompaniments!

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Chicken Dinner
Martha serves up a delicious chicken dinner with fresh ingredients from her greenhouse; joined by her good friend Kevin Sharkey, they celebrate the perfect meal for a taste of home-cooked goodness.

title: Martha Holidays
description:
S2 E5 — Homemade Holidays
Martha and her closest friends create the perfect homemade food gifts for the holidays from caramel popcorn and fancy nut mix to Martha's favorite homemade holiday cocktails.
